overview.summary: Luclin’s history is defined by secrecy, ancient empires, and the eternal struggle between light and shadow.

timeline.name: The Veiling
timeline.description: Luclin is magically hidden from Norrath, its existence erased from mortal knowledge.

timeline.name: Rise of the Akheva
timeline.description: The Akheva empire flourishes, mastering astral magic and establishing dominion over the moon.

timeline.name: Shissar Exile
timeline.description: Shissar refugees arrive on Luclin after fleeing Norrath’s Greenmist, establishing hidden enclaves.

timeline.name: Shadowfracture
timeline.description: Shadow energy ruptures across Luclin, destabilizing Akhevan rule and corrupting entire regions.

timeline.name: Current Era
timeline.description: Luclin stands divided between light and shadow, its civilizations fractured and its arcane stability volatile.

key_events.name: Collapse of the Akheva
key_events.description: The Akhevan empire falls after catastrophic astral backlash.

key_events.name: Shadow Expansion
key_events.description: Shadow energy spreads across Luclin, creating the Umbral Plains.
